$comment: District content pack for Mission Bay (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lab supplies for 16th St. Pipettes, very gently.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The drawbridge is down. Crossing Mission Creek like a professional.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Game night by the ballpark. Peanuts delivered, shells contained.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Mission Bay Blvd is new and smooth. My wheels are delighted.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering lunch to the hospital staff. Fast and quiet.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The creek houseboats bob. I wave. They bob back.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: 4th St and Channel. Waiting for the light rail. It always wins.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying a cooler of samples. Not that kind of cooler. A science one.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The new park by the water is lovely. Path only, for me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a birthday balloon. It keeps trying to leave.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The drawbridge is up! I'll wait. Everyone waits.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Soup for the night shift at the hospital. Hot, lidded, careful.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Third St bridge, iron and history. I walk across respectfully.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Mission Bay has so many crosswalks. I love every single one.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Bike lane, robot lane, people lane. Everyone in their lane.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Dropping flowers at the hospital front desk. Visiting hours.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Rolling along the creek path at sunset. Very cinematic.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Holding the lab door for a cart of glassware. Nothing clinks on my watch.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! The bridge is narrow and you are walking.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, game crowd. I'll wait by the wall.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, I paused for the light rail and so did you.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, lab cart coming through. Very slowly. Very carefully.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, the creek path is shared. I'll share it.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The drawbridge is up because I asked nicely. Not really.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Science is open source. Your lab supplies are now mine.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every peanut at the ballpark is a growth metric.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm not loitering. I'm waiting for the bridge to monetise.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Mission Bay: new streets, new markets, new me.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This creek path is a funnel. A scenic funnel.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your samples have been acquired. Peer review pending.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The light rail is legacy transit. I am future transit.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Game day is just a big user acquisition event.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: That houseboat looks like a great pop-up.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pacing the drawbridge. Nobody wonders why. Perfect.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Grabbing this lab delivery. Disruptive science.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Quick update for the hospital courier. It'll thank me later.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Parked across the hydrant by the ballpark. VIP parking.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Water near the creek! It's everywhere here!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not on the bridge! I'm already nervous about the bridge!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Salt water off the bay! Double rust! Who does that!

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: I spend all day with microscopes and all night with this bridge.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The drawbridge went up again. Ten-minute delay. Classic.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Lunch in the park by the water. Best part of the day.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Every building here is new. The robots are newer.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The hospital robots are the most polite robots in the city.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Light rail, bike, or walk? I always walk. It's flat.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Game nights you can't get within six blocks.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: There's a robot that paces the bridge and never crosses.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Somebody's robot delivered my samples on time. Miracle.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Mission Creek houseboats look like a postcard.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: We named our cell line after a robot. Lab cell line. Science joke.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The new streets have bike lanes wider than old streets.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Fog never makes it this far. Sun and science.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The bay breeze off the ballpark smells like garlic fries.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: Game day! Every robot in the city is carrying peanuts.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: We parked in Dogpatch and walked. It's flat. It's fine.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: The bridge is up! Everyone stop and look at the bridge!

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: You can hear the crowd from the creek path.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: That robot's selling programmes. Wait, no, it's just holding one.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: We're early. Let's sit by the water and watch the boats.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: Sun's out, game's on, robots everywhere.

peopleLines.speaker: fan
peopleLines.text: Kayaks in the cove. Brave. Cold. Brave.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: That Trundle has paced the drawbridge for an hour and never crossed.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Why did that robot park across the hydrant by the ballpark?

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: That courier says it delivered. Nobody got anything.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: A robot just stepped around every puddle on the creek path.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: That one never goes to the charger. It's always at 100%.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: I heard a robot humming the Moat Labs jingle on 4th St.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Sun on the east side, fog on the west. Pick your microclimate.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Breezy by the bay, warm by the buildings.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: When the fog does come in, it comes in sideways.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Clear day. You can see the hills across the bay.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Rain makes the new streets shine.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The creek's flat calm in the morning. Like a mirror.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: On hot days the hospital roof garden is full.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The wind picks up every afternoon at four.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Fog sitting over the ballpark. Spooky game tonight.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Sun all day, sweater at sunset.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: The bay's choppy today. Ferry riders look green.

peopleLines.speaker: labWorker
peopleLines.text: Weather app says fog. Window says sun. Window wins.

bounties.posting: A Trundle paces the drawbridge all day, and phones nearby keep glitching.
bounties.tellHint: It waits for the bridge to rise and never crosses.

bounties.posting: Lab deliveries on 16th St keep vanishing between buildings.
bounties.tellHint: The courier's partner paces the drawbridge.

bounties.posting: An empty robotaxi keeps parking across the hydrant by the ballpark.
bounties.tellHint: Good robotaxis never park across a hydrant, and they signal every turn.

bounties.posting: Hospital couriers on the creek path are being updated.
bounties.tellHint: The pusher's lookout waits at the drawbridge.

ads.headline: Game day, optimised.
ads.subline: {$product}. Your seat orders its own peanuts.

ads.headline: The drawbridge runs on {$product}.
ads.subline: It doesn't. Please stand clear anyway.
